metadata.title: Model B3 basic creep - worked example Sec. 1.4.5 (sealed cylinder, t'=28 d, sigma=0.4*fc)

source.journal: ACI SP-194, Adam Neville Symposium (2000), pp. 1-83

metadata.validation_method: analytical reference: B3 compliance function Eq. (1.7) with approximate Q, Eq. (1.35)
metadata.validation_target: Axial strain history under sustained compression; J(112,28)=0.4107e-6/psi=59.56e-6/MPa -> strain 657e-6 at 84 d load duration
metadata.notes: VERIFICATION case with analytical reference, not an experimental validation. Sealed specimen (h=1.0): drying creep Cd and shrinkage are identically zero, so no humidity field and no drying_shrinkage coupling. Simulation t=0 corresponds to concrete age 28 d (age_at_start_days=28). Geometry is a quarter of a D=6 in cylinder (v/s=0.75 in) but is immaterial: sealed + uniform uniaxial stress => no size effect. ASSUMED: specimen dimensions (not stated in paper; zero impact on target), plane-stress thickness (cancels for prescribed traction).

entities._comment: ASSUMED: quarter-cylinder wedge, radius 0.075 m (D=6 in from v/s=0.75 in, Sec. 1.4.5), height 0.30 m. Sealed => geometry does not affect compliance.

points.name: probe_top
points._comment: on the node grid for element_size 0.0075 (5 and 40 elements)

displacement._comment_rho: INFERRED: c + w + a = 219.5 + 131.9 + 1536.2 kg/m3 from the Sec. 1.4.5 mix proportions. Quasi-static creep run with no gravity load and no dynamics, so rho has zero impact on the validation target — it is only a builder requirement.
displacement._comment_nu: PAPER_VALUE: creep Poisson ratio = instantaneous = 0.18 (Commentary C6)
displacement._comment_thickness: ASSUMED: cancels for prescribed traction; strain is the validation target

b3_creep._comment_q: PAPER_VALUE: Eq. 1.16-1.18 (SI) for fc=27.58 MPa, c=219.45 kg/m3, w/c=0.60, a/c=7.0, converted 1e-6/MPa -> 1/Pa. Paper's worked inch-pound values: q1=0.1664, q2=0.9564, q3=0.0359, q4=0.0358 x1e-6/psi
b3_creep._comment_nmr: PAPER_VALUE: m=0.5, n=0.1 (Eq. 1.6); r=1.7 is the coefficient in r(t')=1.7*t'^0.12+8 (Eq. 1.36)
b3_creep._comment_age: simulation t=0 = concrete age 28 d = age at loading t'

boundary_conditions._comment: PAPER_VALUE: sigma = 1600 psi = 11.032 MPa = 0.4*fc, compression, applied at sim t=0 (age 28 d) and held constant

time_stepping._comment_t_end: 7257600 s = 84 d = age 112 d - t' 28 d, the paper's worked endpoint
time_stepping._comment_dt: log spacing 0.001 d -> 5 d resolves the compliance curve over ~4 decades

reference_curves.label: B3 analytical, Eq. 1.7 (Sec. 1.4.5)
reference_curves._comment: computed from Eq. 1.7 with approximate Q (Eq. 1.35); strain = -J*sigma, compression negative; cross-check J(84 d)=59.56e-6/MPa vs paper 0.4107e-6/psi

queries.label: Axial strain [-]
queries._comment: uniform stress state: strain = u_top / height

plots.name: strain_history
plots.title: Basic creep, sealed, t' = 28 d (B3 worked example Sec. 1.4.5)
